title: game-intel sourced claim
description: Public POST /v1/claims body. No API key. statement, sources, and game_id are required. sources must be https URLs with a real host (not javascript:, data:, http:, empty, IP literals, localhost, or placeholder hosts such as example.com). Caps: statement 2000 chars, 1–8 sources, each URL ≤ 500, body ≤ 16384 bytes. Rate limit: 10 per IP per Asia/Shanghai hour and 100 per calendar day globally.

game.description: Alias of game_id. The API accepts either.
